description.value: Woking Dragon Chop Suey House is a family-owned Chinese restaurant chain operating since 2003, offering modern western-style Chinese cuisine with a nod to traditional recipes. The Maple Ridge location sits on Dewdney Trunk Road and is one of three Lower Mainland locations. It has earned recognition as a favourite Chinese restaurant in the Tri-Cities area.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 18m. Total: 4 spaces.
